decisive_items: a posterior epidural mass from D5 to D7
homogeneously hyperintense on both T1-weighted and T2-weighted sequences, suggestive of fat
response.rationale: MRI shows a posterior epidural fat-signal mass causing cord compression, which is the defining feature of spinal epidural lipomatosis; the other labels are either generic or syndromic.

rejected.why: An epidural mass with fat signal is not an intraspinal tumor; no neoplastic or enhancing features are described.
Spinal cord compression describes the clinical syndrome caused by the mass, not the underlying fat-containing diagnosis.
Accurate as a descriptive imaging label, but less specific than spinal epidural lipomatosis for the clinical-radiologic picture.
